Dear Priya,
Happy Birthday, Chaudhary Jii! 🎂

I tried building you a website that said everything properly. Five versions later, I realised the honest part is simple.

Somewhere between the snaps, the cold coffees and the 11 AM cafe chats, you became my favourite person to talk to. You notice the little things, you make ordinary days feel worth keeping, and you carry a kind of light that people feel the moment you walk in.

So here it is, no filters: I have feelings for you, Priya. I love who you are, the overthinking and the laugh and all of it.

You don't have to answer today. There's no wrong reply, and our friendship stays exactly as precious either way. Overthinkers get unlimited time, so take yours.
Yours, always,
Himanshu Mittal
